definitions.explanation: A solemn promise or commitment, often made with deep personal conviction or in a formal ceremonial context. Carries more weight and formality than a simple promise.

examples.english: The two made a vow of love.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誓|ちか}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刻|きざ}んだ→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧。
examples.english: I engraved my New Year's pledge in my heart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正々堂々|せいせいどうどう}→正々堂々：25225_seiseidoudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誓|ちか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: The athletes declared their pledge to compete fairly and squarely.

notes:
USAGE:
{誓|ちか}い is the noun form of ⟦{誓|ちか}う→誓う：00030_chikau⟧ (to swear, to vow). It carries a solemn, weighty tone — stronger than ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧ (promise). Common contexts include wedding vows, oaths of office, and personal resolutions. The phrase {誓|ちか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (words of pledge) is used at ceremonies. It is a homophone of ⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧ (near), which has a completely different meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誓|ちか}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to make a vow
- {誓|ちか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: pledge, oath (at ceremonies)
- ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誓|ちか}い: vow of love
- {誓|ちか}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to keep one's vow
